<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=08|day=8|content=

* U.S. intelligence officials and non-government experts conclude that diplomatic efforts to prevent the proliferation of [[nuclear weapon]]s to [[Iran]] and [[North Korea]] have failed to slow their weapons development programs.
* [[Sudan]] seeks support from states attending the [[Arab League]] summit in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]] to forestall possible [[United Nations]] sanctions against their country regarding its support for the [[Arab]] [[Janjaweed]] accused of [[ethnic cleansing]] in [[Darfur]]. Arab League Secretary General [[Amr Moussa]] states that the Arab League states are inclined to help Sudan avoid sanctions. [https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=topNews&storyID=5904310 (Reuters)] {{Webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20040820053130/http://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=topNews&storyID=5904310 |date=2004-08-20 }}
* Militants in [[Iraq]] kidnap the [[Iran]]ian Consul assigned to [[Karbala]], stating that the consul has been acting in ways incompatible with his [[diplomat]]ic status. [https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=worldNews&storyID=5904233 (Reuters)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050408154537/http://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=worldNews&storyID=5904233 |date=2005-04-08 }}
* [[Palestinian Authority]] Justice [[Nahed Arreyes]] resigns, stating that he has been stripped of much of his authority over the legal system. [http://washingtontimes.com/world/20040807-112344-3852r.htm (AP)]
* An [[Iraq]]i judge issues an [[arrest warrant]] for [[Ahmed Chalabi]] on the charge of [[counterfeiting]]. Chalabi denies the charge. [http://www.voanews.com/article.cfm?objectID=DB163A96-EC24-4294-B48DD10046F6CB36 (Voice of America)]
* A tour bus belonging to the Dave Matthews Band [[2004 Dave Matthews Band Chicago River incident|dumped an estimated 800 pounds of human waste]] from the bus's septic tank onto a passenger sightseeing boat on the [[Chicago River]] below.
